rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees renewing for the first time are exempt from CE.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours do not carry over to a later registration period.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or approved by AAMFT or affiliates; courses accredited, approved or offered by COAMFTE, NBCC, ACA, NASW, ASWB or APA (if related to MFT practice); COAMFTE-accredited institutions; graduate coursework or programs of regionally accredited institutions
rules.audit_note: Certificates must be submitted to the Department on request.

topics.who: First renewal period in which CE is required, then at least once every six years (veterans' mental health incl. suicide prevention)

rules.notes: License renewal due the last day of the birth month, annually. Face-to-face instruction or home study programs. Keep certificates 3 years. MFT associates must meet the same CE requirement.
rules.legal_basis: Conn. Gen. Stat. §20-195c(d); Regs. Conn. State Agencies §§20-195c-1 to 20-195c-7
